summary: WEKL, broadcasting on 102.3 MHz as "102.3 K-Love", is a Contemporary Christian radio station licensed by the FCC to Augusta, Georgia, with an ERP of 1.5 kW. The station's studios are at the Augusta Corporate Center alongside the market's other iHeartMedia-owned sister stations. Its transmitter is located in Augusta near Fort Gordon.
one_line: WEKL, "102.3 K-Love", is a Contemporary Christian radio station licensed to Augusta, Georgia, owned by iHeartMedia.
key_facts: WEKL is known on-air as "102.3 K-Love".
WEKL is a Contemporary Christian radio station in the United States.
WEKL is licensed by the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to Augusta, Georgia.
WEKL has an ERP of 1.5 kW.
The studios of WEKL are located at the Augusta Corporate Center.
WEKL's studios are shared with the market's other iHeartMedia owned sister stations in Augusta.
The transmitter of WEKL is located in Augusta near Fort Gordon.
